name: halo
description: A HUD over a live background: windows are dark smoked glass that let the scene behind them glow through, media sits edge to edge at the top of a card with a bold title and a quiet meta line under it, and one sky blue is the only signal. Every surface floats, so every surface is glass — but never thinner than 72% fill, so text keeps its contrast.

source.note: The halo HUD (an agent interface whose windows float over a live wave or the user's desktop), 2026-09-25, and a reference screenshot of a research canvas the owner shared for the card anatomy — media first, bold title, meta line, a small tab floating above the card. Design values only; no product's marks, wording or screen layouts are reproduced.
